newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile to buy two French submarines - report.
newsitem.headline: Chile to buy two French submarines - report.

text.p: Chile has decided to buy two French nuclear-powered Scorpene submarines after studying offers from at least four countries, El Mercurio newspaper reported on Sunday.
The first submarine will arrive within the next four or five years the paper quoted Defence Minister Edmundo Perez Yoma as saying.

Military sources said the two submarines, which will replace the Chilean navy's aging British submarines, will cost under $450 million. The navy is planning eventually to build a third vessel at its own shipyard at the port of Talcahuano.

The Scorpene beat off competition from British, Swedish and German shipbuilders. One of the deciding factors was that the French submarine is especially silent, making it difficult to detect, El Mercurio said.

The deal is part of a plan by Chile's armed forces to upgrade their aging weaponry. The army recently ordered tanks from Belgium and the airforce is said to be interested in buying new high-technology jets.
